North Gyeongsang (경상북도) — Zuid-Korea Reisgids: Bezienswaardigheden, Bereikbaarheid & Eten

Gyeongju Bulguksa, Seokguram & Daereungwon Tombs, Andong Hahoe Folk Village, Pohang Homigot & Space Walk, JuWangsan National Park. KTX to Gyeongju (Singyeongju), Pohang, Andong and Gimcheon-Gumi stations.

Regio / ProvincieNorth Gyeongsang (경상북도)
Belangrijkste KnooppuntAndong Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)
Alle Steden397

Bereikbaarheid & Openbaar Vervoer

KTX to Gyeongju (Singyeongju), Pohang, Andong and Gimcheon-Gumi stations.

Lokale Keuken & Specialiteiten

  • Andong Jjimdak (braised chicken)
  • Gyeongju Hwangnam-ppang & Gyori Gimbap
  • Pohang Gwamegi & Mulhoe
  • Andong Hanwoo beef
